name: neon-border
title: Neon Border
description: A rounded panel wrapped in a thin gradient ring that glows outward in two colours. Three versions show the glow travelling around the edge, covering half or all of the border, or sitting still.
use: A dark landing panel, pricing tier or status card that should read as futuristic and draw the eye without extra artwork.
avoid: Built for dark surfaces: the heavy glow washes out on light backgrounds, and the full variant never stops looping.
a11y: The border animation runs forever with no prefers-reduced-motion pause, which can bother motion-sensitive viewers. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three stacked rounded rectangles on black, each ringed by a thin gradient stroke that fades between two colours and casts a soft coloured haze. The top ring runs blue to pink, the middle purple to magenta all the way round, the bottom green to orange. White label text sits centred inside each dark panel.
behaves: The animated rings slide their colour band around the perimeter on a loop, so the glow travels steadily; the half version lights only half the edge, the full closes around, and the static one stays put. Nothing reacts to the pointer.
customise: Set the two glow colours, animation type (none/half/full), loop duration and className through props; the inner content is whatever you pass as children.
weight: light: Three gradient layers with blur and drop-shadow driven by one CSS keyframe loop.
